LABEL: general Labelled Magnitude Scale
A IAO:0000115: A rating scale running from zero to one hundred with quasi-logarithmically spaced verbal anchors from barely detectable to strongest imaginable sensation of any kind, permitting comparison of intensities across people.

LABEL: Labelled Magnitude Scale
A IAO:0000115: A rating scale running from zero to one hundred with verbal anchors referring to the strongest imaginable taste sensation rather than to any sensation.

LABEL: nine-point hedonic scale
A IAO:0000115: A rating scale with nine categories running from dislike extremely to like extremely, used to record liking.

LABEL: visual analogue scale
A IAO:0000115: A rating scale on which the taster marks a point on an unstructured line of stated length, conventionally one hundred millimetres.

LABEL: just-about-right scale
A IAO:0000115: A rating scale with categories running from far too little to far too much about a stated attribute, centred on just about right.

LABEL: PROP filter paper strip protocol
A IAO:0000115: An assay in which a taster places a filter paper impregnated with propylthiouracil on the tongue and reports the bitterness, used to assign taster status.
